startupLatency.scope: Observed original native-Promise calls on this Game device during Game.start. shaderAttribution.scope: Observed original validated shader Promise jobs only. IDs are local technical identities. Terminal mapping reads current data slots; last cached batches are not new visibility/readiness evaluation. Missing earlier/retired modules stay unobserved. No shader text/defines/GPU objects, new getCompilationInfo/render/await or whole-scene dump.
